_instructions_for_llm: This is a task list. When given this file plus an update (notes, a message, a meeting summary, etc.), return the COMPLETE updated JSON in the same structure.
Keep every existing task unless the update says to remove it. Never change a task's id.
New tasks get the next id in sequence (T-001, T-002, ...). Set created to today's date.
When a task's status changes, update updated and add a short entry to its history.
Set completed to the date a task moved to 'done'; leave it null otherwise.
Allowed status values: todo, in_progress, blocked, done, cancelled.
Allowed priority values: high, medium, low.
If something in the update is unclear, do not guess: add it to open_questions instead.
Update meta.last_updated and write a one-paragraph meta.summary of what changed.
Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. Output valid JSON only, with no commentary before or after it.

meta.summary: What changed in the most recent update.

tasks.title: Short, action-first description of the task
tasks.details: Any extra context, links or acceptance criteria.

open_questions.question: Anything the LLM couldn't resolve from the update
